title: Annotation API image embedding response
description: Response body of POST /api/dinov2/ and POST /api/openclip-image/. The server sends every key listed here, with null when there is no value.

ts.description: UTC time at which the response was produced, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

ci_id.description: The request `id`; otherwise `auto-0` for raw, multipart or base64 `bytes` input, and null for `bytes_b64`, `path` or `url` input. Not an Impresso content-item id.

embedding.description: Image embedding, not L2-normalised, rounded to 5 decimals. On `openclip-image` it is in the same space as `openclip-text`, which is L2-normalised: divide by this vector's norm to get a cosine.

model_id.description: Identifier of the model that produced the response.

seconds.description: Processing time of the request, in seconds.
